title: North, South, East, West
subject: English
summary: “North, South, East, West” is a chapter that teaches us about the four main directions and how to find our way using them. It explains the importance of directions in our daily lives and how maps and other natural signs help us identify different places. It also helps us understand how people travel from one place to another. The chapter encourages us to explore the world around us and learn about different locations. It teaches us that knowledge of directions helps us understand our surroundings and find our way easily.
